thread:
leah_g: Heads up — found a couple of small but important inconsistencies in the rate limits / quotas docs while drafting the SDK migration guide. Can we triage?
jonathan: Thanks — what did you find?
leah_g: 1) The 429 body example in `docs/api/errors.md` still shows `retry_after` in seconds. The runtime now returns `retry_after_ms` (milliseconds). Docs should show both fields (legacy clients) and recommend `retry_after_ms` as source of truth.
amanda: oh that explains some support tickets where clients miscalculate backoff.
kevin_dev: 2) The quota tier section for "tiered billing" doesn't mention the burst credits behavior — specifically that bursts consume a temporary bucket and are visible under the dashboard as `burst_used`. We should add an example and a small SDK snippet showing how to read the `x-burst-remaining` header.
olex: also the dashboard link in that doc points to `/usage/tiers` which currently 302s to the new path; broken link checker flagged it.
docs-bot: Link-checker: 1 broken internal link (docs/usage -> 302 redirect).
jonathan: OK actionable items: fix 429 example, add burst header note + snippet, update dashboard link, and add a short migration note in the SDK guide. Who wants to take which?
kevin_dev: I can add the SDK snippets (JS + Python) and the burst header note. Here's a draft JS snippet to include:```js
// show remaining burst tokens header
const resp = await client.generate({model: 'rw-large', input: 'Hi'});
console.log('burst remaining:', resp.headers['x-burst-remaining']);
```
kevin_dev: and Python:```py
resp = client.generate(model='rw-large', input='Hi')
print('burst remaining:', resp.headers.get('x-burst-remaining'))
```
amanda: I'll update the 429 example and add a small blurb about clients preferring `retry_after_ms` (ms) over `retry_after` (s). Draft text: "When you receive a 429, check `retry_after_ms` first — if absent, fall back to `retry_after` (seconds). Convert seconds to ms before scheduling retries."
leah_g: perfect. For the dashboard link, change to `https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers` and add a short parenthetical that teams need the "Billing Viewer" role to see per-tier consumption.
jonathan: Sounds good. Can we bundle these into one docs PR so the migration guide and the API errors file are updated together? Keeps release tidy.
kevin_dev: I'll open the PR and add reviewers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/514 — includes snippets, header mention, and tests for link redirects.
leah_g: assigning review: @jonathan and @amanda. Please review by EOD tomorrow if possible.
jonathan: will do, leaving comments inline.
amanda: added a wording tweak for the retry text — see PR.
docs-bot: CI: docs-link-check passed, markdown-lint flagged one long line in js snippet (fixed).
kevin_dev: pushed fix. Anyone want a quick paired review on the migration note wording? I can jump on a 15 min call.
leah_g: I can in 15.
olex: after merge, can we also add a short metric to the usage dashboard: `burst_used` per org? Ops needs that for cost forecasting. That will be a separate infra ticket but mention it in the PR as an action item.
leah_g: adding note in PR description: "Follow-up: infra ticket to expose `burst_used` metric to dashboard (TKT-2087)."
jonathan: great. Thanks all — once PR merges I'll schedule a small changelog blurb and ping support so they know clients should prefer `retry_after_ms`.
kevin_dev: marked as ready for review. :thumbsup:
leah_g: thanks — closing the loop here.
